### Context

The current checker is absent at `scripts/issue-readiness.mjs`; the dispatch contract lives in `.agents/skills/planning/references/issue-standard.md`. Related recovery is #6172.

### Scope fence

Add the structural receipt and consumer. Non-goal: do not score prose quality.

### Decisions already made

All schema and fail-closed decisions are resolved in #6253.

### Acceptance criteria

- A complete structural brief emits ready. Evidence: named test `emits ready through main`.
- A moving issue emits unknown. Evidence: fixture `mid-read-mutation` through `scripts/issue-readiness.test.mjs`.

### Verification plan

```text
pnpm vitest run --config ./vitest.scripts.config.mjs scripts/issue-readiness.test.mjs
```

### Footprint & chain

`scripts/issue-readiness.mjs`, `.github/workflows/issue-readiness.yml`. Callers: the trusted workflow and runnable-set consumer.

### Operator actions

none

### Glossary impact

Terms: receipt is owned by `.agents/skills/planning/references/issue-standard.md`.

### External authority probe & evidence timing

Captured GitHub fixture `scripts/fixtures/issue-readiness-v1.json` at dispatch-time collection before lane admission.

### Review packet seed

Invariants: only complete revision-bound authority is ready. Failure modes: page truncation, movement, and malformed forms. Evidence: omission fixtures and the focused attack commands.

### Tier + routing hint

full path; system.
